title: CODATA 2022: the alpha-particle mass is 6.644 657 3450 × 10⁻²⁷ kg
summary: The mass ratio to the electron is 7294.299 541 71. The energy equivalent is 3727.379 4118 MeV.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'alpha particle mass 6.644 657 3450 e-27' kg, standard uncertainty '0.000 000 0021 e-27' kg. 'alpha particle-electron mass ratio 7294.299 541 71', standard uncertainty '0.000 000 17'. 'alpha particle mass energy equivalent in MeV 3727.379 4118', standard uncertainty '0.000 0012' MeV. 'alpha particle mass in u 4.001 506 179 129', standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 062' u.

sources.title: Fundamental Physical Constants, complete listing, 2022 CODATA adjustment
sources.author: NIST, CODATA 2022 recommended values
sources.note: Complete listing of the 2022 CODATA adjustment, opened 2026-11-18. Digits are copied from lines that were printed in full, without an ellipsis.
